normative: Every named field is required unless explicitly optional. Undefined wire versions fail. The exact pinned consumer source is also mandatory; do not infer a relaxed producer contract from abbreviated field descriptions.

encoding.json: UTF-8 ASCII canonical json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False), unique keys, integer numbers only, object at document root
encoding.digest: SHA256 lowercase64 hex, except OCI image digest sha256:<64hex>
encoding.frame: 8 ASCII magic bytes || uint32LE payload length || payload, plus exactly384 PSS signature bytes on proof only
encoding.signature: RSA modulus exactly3072 bits; e65537; PSS SHA256; MGF1-SHA256; salt exactly32; signed domain || full proof frame excluding signature

binding.packet_manifest_sha256: lowercase hex64 of whole current input subject
binding.admission_sha256: lowercase hex64 of current admission raw file
binding.control_admission_sha256: actual per-request dedicated control admission SHA; not immutable baseline SHA
binding.producer_descriptor_sha256: exact SDK-approved new producer descriptor; old R5 approval cannot be inherited
binding.controller: {pid:positive integer,birth:positive decimal string}; exact live kernel identity
binding.guardian: {pid:positive integer,birth:positive decimal string}; distinct PID from controller
binding.canonical_lease: {device,inode,owner_pid,owner_birth,owner_fd}; exact original inode and acquiring controller FD
binding.own_interruption_sha256: current subject own two actual interruption proof SHA
binding.own_benign_sha256: current subject own bounded retired benign SHA

challenge.challenge: 32 bytes OS CSPRNG represented64 lowerhex; unique per guard
challenge.caller: direct SDK kernel self mapping described below

caller.host_pid: actual host PID translated using kernel NS/membership mapping
caller.namespaces: exact pid,mnt,user,cgroup,time {device,inode,link}; witness derives host peer via SO_PEERCRED then reads kernel, never request echo

batch.slots: unique integer slot list; <=64; exact order of rights after first2 overhead FDs in batch0
batch.proof_sha256: SHA entire proof frame including signature
batch.ancillary: only SOL_SOCKET/SCM_RIGHTS; batch0 exactly enrollmentFD,proofFD,slotFDs; later exactly slotFDs. No MSG_TRUNC/MSG_CTRUNC, trailing messages, skipped/duplicate/unconsumed slots. MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC mandatory.

enrollment.issued_monotonic_ns: actual CLOCK_MONOTONIC after pinned issuer finished measurements
enrollment.deadline_monotonic_ns: issued<deadline<=issued+1800s; current same-clock now within bounds
enrollment.public_key: {n_hex:768 lowercasehex characters,e:65537}; only this root-enrolled key allowed
enrollment.issuer: fields: boot_id,bootstrap_manifest_sha256,source_manifest_sha256,runtime_manifest_sha256,executable_sha256,image_sha256,security_profile,lsm_profile,shared_ancestor:{device,inode},actual_cgroup:{memory.max,memory.swap.max,cpuset.cpus.effective}. Whole exact pinned root issuer closure and real PID/birth/state/probes also retained as originals; SDK-owned source approval is required before an issuer is trusted.
enrollment.control_roles: exact controller and guardian objects: pid,birth,launch_receipt_sha256,lsm_profile:unconfined,namespaces,executable:{identity,...}; root issuer measures real roles, not supplied JSON alone

sources.identity: object with exact device,inode,bytes,mode,uid,gid,mtime_ns,ctime_ns integer fields; mode is permission bits; signed tuple equals actual fstat

runtime.identity: object with exact device,inode,bytes,mode,uid,gid,mtime_ns,ctime_ns integer fields; mode is permission bits; signed tuple equals actual fstat

measurements.maps_text: complete current raw /proc/PID/maps; <=2097152 bytes; every file map must join pinned retained runtime VFS; anonymous executable maps refused except kernel vdso/vsyscall
measurements.cmdline_before_hex: actual raw argv before enrollment sampling
measurements.cmdline_after_hex: same actual argv after enrollment sampling
measurements.environ_before_hex: actual raw environ before enrollment sampling
measurements.environ_after_hex: same actual environ after enrollment sampling
measurements.sealed_launch: {fd,raw,sha256,identity,before_identity,after_identity,seals:15,access_mode:O_RDONLY}; exact raw sealed launch bytes measured by root
measurements.sealed_launch_document: format uwvm-sealed-witness-launch-v1; fields binding,context_path,source_manifest_sha256,runtime_manifest_sha256,bootstrap_contract_sha256; complete exact launch/source-FD closure in approved bootstrap

proof.challenge: echo only after independently authenticating actual peer
proof.caller: independently measured peer, equals SDK direct self mapping
proof.live_view_sha256: exact request value, only after witness independently verifies whole current producer live view against actual kernel facts
proof.sample_started_ns: actual measurement begin >= client challenge started
proof.fd_table: exact rows in fd_table below; complete current source/runtime/exe/metadata and2 lease-reader slots, no extras
proof.roles: exact controller and guardian facts described below

role_facts.security: actual kernel status, exact original host profile
role_facts.namespaces: exact current pid,mnt,user,cgroup,time identities; equal root enrollment

kernel.stat_before: raw actual /proc/PID/stat read before current sample
kernel.stat_after: raw actual same PID stat after sample; both same enrolled birth and live state
kernel.exe_before: object with exact device,inode,bytes,mode,uid,gid,mtime_ns,ctime_ns integer fields; mode is permission bits; signed tuple equals actual fstat
kernel.exe_after: same actual current executable fstat as exe_before
kernel.cmdline_hex: lowercase hex raw actual kernel NUL-terminated argv bytes
kernel.environ_hex: lowercase hex raw actual kernel NUL-terminated environment
kernel.maps_text: complete current raw /proc/PID/maps; <=2097152 bytes; every file map must join pinned retained runtime VFS; anonymous executable maps refused except kernel vdso/vsyscall

role_facts.retained_runtime_paths: sorted exact current used/retained runtime path set measured from closed loader+kernel retained-FD census; equals all live runtime_descriptors. This differs from the complete1346-file available runtime input inventory; full available input set is separately provisioned and hash-qualified.
role_facts.context_document: actual current host context parsed document; equals sealed original context except measured lease_owner
role_facts.context_raw: actual complete raw UTF-8 context file bytes
role_facts.context_identity_before: object with exact device,inode,bytes,mode,uid,gid,mtime_ns,ctime_ns integer fields; mode is permission bits; signed tuple equals actual fstat
role_facts.control_admission_raw: complete original UTF-8 raw bytes matching exact admission SHA
role_facts.public_context_identity: {device,inode}; actual current host public context directory VFS matches SDK readonly view

fresh_witness.cgroup: actual current namespace-aware shared leaf VFS/membership and64GiB/swap0/cpuset fields
fresh_witness.security: exact UID/GID1000, Groups empty or1000, all capability sets including Bnd0, NNP1/seccomp2
fresh_witness.caller: actual host SO_PEERCRED peer mapped facts

kernel.stat_before: raw actual /proc/PID/stat read before current sample
kernel.stat_after: raw actual same PID stat after sample; both same enrolled birth and live state
kernel.exe_before: object with exact device,inode,bytes,mode,uid,gid,mtime_ns,ctime_ns integer fields; mode is permission bits; signed tuple equals actual fstat
kernel.exe_after: same actual current executable fstat as exe_before
kernel.cmdline_hex: lowercase hex raw actual kernel NUL-terminated argv bytes
kernel.environ_hex: lowercase hex raw actual kernel NUL-terminated environment
kernel.maps_text: complete current raw /proc/PID/maps; <=2097152 bytes; every file map must join pinned retained runtime VFS; anonymous executable maps refused except kernel vdso/vsyscall

fresh_witness.sources: same complete measured original sealed source rows as root enrollment; witness actually rechecks each retained FD each sample
fresh_witness.loaded_images: complete current ordered map projection; equal root enrolled images; no post-lock new image

fd_table.identity: object with exact device,inode,bytes,mode,uid,gid,mtime_ns,ctime_ns integer fields; mode is permission bits; signed tuple equals actual fstat
fd_table.sha256: full received bytes SHA; for proc reader current raw kernel fdinfo SHA
fd_table.original_fdinfo: complete raw actual original role FDinfo <=65536 bytes
fd_table.kernel_path: lease: exact /proc/<hostPID>/fdinfo/<originalFD>; other kinds exact inspected actual target path
fd_table.original_identity_before: actual target FD fstat before sample; canonical lease file fstat for lease_fdinfo
fd_table.witness_delivery_fd: actual witness sender FD number retained until complete reply
fd_table.reopen_kernel_check: {syscall:kcmp(KCMP_FILE),first_pid:witnessPID,second_pid:rolePID,first_fd:witness_delivery_fd,second_fd:original_fd,result:1|2|3,errno:0}. kcmp is supplemental to object-type/full-identity checks and qualified never-replaced original FD lifetimes; no SIGSTOP, ptrace attach, descriptor control or fallback permission change.

legacy_role_payloads: The inner exact source-manifest/runtime-manifest/closed-launch/role receipt/role live-state formats remain v2 shapes; their new source/descriptor pins are mandatory. Base closed-launch protocol literal remains uwvm-sdk-live-boundary-v2 for that inner execution contract. Admission/guardian/live lease observation outer format is v3. This explicit layering is not v2 approval inheritance.
fail_closed: Any malformed/unknown/missing field, stale actor or evidence, unsupported/denied syscall, LSM mismatch, invalid signature, root enrollment failure, unsafe FD, extra slot, path alias, resource/lease loss or physical retirement error blocks the subject. No SDK guard fallback to old direct-proc or mutable records.
